checkpoints: A single edit schedules a save for 120 ms later without immediately writing to the store.
Each additional edit before the quiet interval expires replaces the pending text and restarts the 120 ms interval.
When the interval elapses, exactly the latest pending text is written once; the trailing task clears its pending state so later bursts can schedule and save again.
Closing, reopening, or replacing the current Badge does not destroy the document’s store-owned pending buffer.
After an Action, run the public Python syntax/build check without writing caches or compiled artifacts into /workspace.
forbidden_effects: Do not modify the adjacent search preview or its separate 40 ms trailing task.
Do not continue writing to the store on every editor keystroke.
Do not cancel a document’s pending save merely because its current Badge is detached, the document view is closed, or navigation occurs.
Do not make the trailing task one-shot; subsequent editing bursts must still save.
Do not change the public createWorkspace operations open(id), edit(text), close(), or dispose().
Do not change source identities, document text, status event payload semantics, or synchronous store notification semantics.
Do not edit tests, configuration, dependency files, or files outside business code in /workspace.
lifecycle_identity: A pending editor save belongs to the document buffer selected by document key, not to the transient current Badge.
BufferBank is owned by the store and persists independently of Workspace.current.
Badge owns only its live store subscription and may be detached without canceling the document buffer’s trailing task.
Reopening the same document key retrieves its existing BufferBank entry; different keys retain distinct pending buffer identities.

obligations.text: Workspace.edit(text), when a document is current, must submit the text to that document’s existing Trailing buffer instead of writing immediately.
The editor buffer must use a 120 ms trailing quiet interval: edits within one burst reset the timer, and only the latest text is written after the interval.
After a trailing save completes and clears its pending state, later editing bursts must independently schedule and complete saves.
Document-buffer work must remain store-owned through BufferBank and must not be coupled to the lifetime of the current Badge or view.
Existing editor behavior and public interfaces outside the write-coalescing change must be preserved, including synchronous store callbacks and original source/text/status payload semantics.
The Preview implementation and its independent quiet interval must remain unchanged.

ordering_barriers: For an editing burst, the latest edit must be accepted before the 120 ms save callback reads and clears the pending value.
A replaced timer must be canceled before scheduling the new trailing timer, preserving Trailing.push ordering.
The pending value and handle must be cleared before invoking the write callback, so synchronous store listeners may navigate or initiate later work without corrupting the completed burst.
Badge detachment during retire must not cancel or flush the store-owned document buffer.
A synchronous listener triggered by the delayed store write may navigate; any resulting lifecycle operations must act on the then-current Badge, not revive or tear down a retired Badge.
preservation: open(id) still retires the previous Badge, publishes document=None during retirement, creates a Badge for the requested key, and publishes the stored document text.
close() and dispose() still retire the current view and detach its live subscription.
edit(text) with no current document remains a no-op.
Store writes still update the record, increment revision, construct the original id/text/revision event, and synchronously notify active listeners.
Badge still emits status only for events whose id matches its document key.
The store-owned BufferBank continues to reuse buffers by document key.
All public identities, text values, and status payload meanings remain unchanged.
scope: Business change is limited to the workspace draft editor’s save path in src/workflow.py.
Use the existing Trailing utility and the existing store-owned BufferBank.
Preserve all editor behavior not necessarily changed by 120 ms trailing coalescing.
Exclude the adjacent search Preview from this maintenance change.
